title: Conflict resolver identity and original decision receipt v1
description: Current identity hints and read-only original-key lookup. Root is the two complete success envelopes, not the resolve HTTP response.
$comment: Source-only; load conflict-read and sync-consumer schemas. Exact original command equality/fingerprint, request key, identity, scope/trace/source and expected+1 relationships require runtime checks. Query ordinary finite JSON limit1000000 bytes/depth64/nodes100000; receipt success2MiB and SQL comparison metadata16KiB.

ConflictCommandIdentity.$comment: Conflict identity uses the same five field lexical rules: scope identifiers exclude dots; actor/client nonblank <=1024 UTF-16 without controls/DEL/lone surrogates. Equality precondition only, never credentials.

requestKey.$comment: Original receipt parser combines nonblank/control-free scalar text with validateIdempotencyKey. This is stricter than the legacy resolve HTTP handler's selected nonempty string key.

ConflictOriginalCommand.$comment: Preserve complete original body plus effective path conflict_id and header/body expected_version. Extras remain fingerprint-significant; do not trim them away. Provided command.idempotency_key equals outer request_key; all supplied identity fields/from_client equal identity. Merge value may be null or any finite JSON. This preparation/query profile is stricter than old raw resolve input.

ConflictReceiptQuery.$comment: Canonical sorted-key detached copy <=1000000 bytes. Arrays, supplied nulls and extra command fields preserved. Not an expected_identity alias or a command to write again.

ConflictCommandContextQuery.description: Empty HTTP/command query. Original identity hints, if any, are independent expected actor/client headers.

ConflictCommandContextEnvelope.$comment: Complete16KiB, actual shared finite JSON parser. Current verified unexpired resolver/admin metadata; no project/database/conflict read or future authorization. No revision/ETag/cursor. Unlike receipt recorded_at, expires_at requires exact four-digit UTC milliseconds.

ConflictRecordedReceipt.$comment: version=String(original expected_version+1); ID/resolution/actor/client equal original query, source event ID binds receipt.event_id. Cursor is bigint decimal string and need not fit safe JS number. Historical trace/time, no copied resolved value or current source state.

ConflictReceiptView.$comment: Original identity/key/complete command echoed with exact canonical equality. not-observed covers clean open row or a resolved row bound to another original key, not missing/hidden conflict. Does not prove rollback, permanent absence or safe resubmission. A legacy resolved row lacking binding is a409 error.

ConflictReceiptEnvelope.$comment: Complete2MiB success. Outer trace=current request, original trace/time=stored decision. No outer scope/revision/ETag/server_cursor; historical cursor is only in receipt. No claim of source-field application.
